trips.route_note: Frequent direct suburban trains (S-Bahn) run from Vienna to Baden bei Wien in well under an hour.
trips.tour_query: Baden bei Wien day trip from Vienna

know: Baden is a spa town with thermal baths and a pedestrian old town
